messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Martin. Your order Shop···· hasn't shipped yet. Your Magic Miner 40T ships November 30.

I'm sorry it's taken this long. You bought it expecting an October 31 date, and we missed it. Right now the order is waiting for the units to arrive at our Tennessee warehouse. We emailed you about the delay on November 3, and again on November 8 with photos from the factory.

You can follow the shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status . Your tracking number will come by email as soon as your miner ships.
